sub.en: Showing respect to elders and subjects using the -(으)시- suffix and honorific endings

desc.en: Free printable Korean worksheet on the subject honorific suffix -(으)시-: how to conjugate with -세요 and -십니다, vowel vs consonant rules, special honorific verbs, practice and an answer key.

sections.note: Rule: stems ending in a vowel take -시- (가세요). Stems ending in a consonant take -으시- (읽으세요). Stems ending in ㄹ drop the ㄹ before ㅅ (살다 → 사세요). Spoken reading: 읽으세요 is pronounced [일그세요] due to liaison.
Important: do not attach -(으)시- to regular words when a special honorific counterpart exists: use 주무시다 instead of '자시다', and 드시다 instead of '먹으시다'.

sections.text: Use -(으)시- exclusively to show respect to the SUBJECT of the action (elders, grandparents, parents, teachers, customers): 할아버지께서 진지를 드세요 (Grandfather is having a meal). NEVER use -(으)시- when speaking about your own actions: 제가 가세요 (X) → 제가 가요 (O).

howto: Attach -시- after vowel stems and -으시- after consonant stems (읽으세요).
Drop ㄹ before ㅅ: 살다 becomes 사세요, 만들다 becomes 만드세요.
Use special honorific verbs for core words: 주무시다 (자다), 드시다 (먹다), 계시다 (있다). Solve Practice A to D.
koSummary: 주어를 높이는 선어말어미 -(으)시-의 어간 결합 규칙(모음/자음/ㄹ 탈락), 특수 높임 동사(주무시다, 드시다, 계시다, 편찮으시다), 그리고 자신에게는 높임말을 쓰지 않는 원칙을 한 장에 정리했습니다.
